declarations.name: Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.exists_actual_metric_variation
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M]
[ChartedSpace Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E M]
[IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M]
(g0 : Poincare.ClosedSmoothRiemannianMetric 3 M) (anchor : M)
(F : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E → Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.Bilin),
ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) F → HasCompactSupport F →
tsupport F ⊆ (extChartAt (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) anchor).target →
(∀ z v w : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E, F z v w = F z w v) →
∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ gt : ℝ → Poincare.ClosedSmoothRiemannianMetric 3 M,
gt 0 = g0 ∧
(∀ s : ℝ, |s| < ε → ∀ x : M,
 (gt s).inner x = g0.inner x + s • Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F x) ∧
∀ s : ℝ, |s| < ε → ∀ z ∈ (extChartAt (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) anchor).target,
_root_.CovariantDerivative.chartMetric (I := Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) (gt s).inner anchor z =
_root_.CovariantDerivative.chartMetric (I := Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) g0.inner anchor z + s • F z
